name: Barbados Welcome Stamp

requirement_groups.name: Remote worker, individual or family bundle

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an annual income of at least USD 50,000 over the 12 months of the stamp.
requirements.fix_path: Document at least USD 50,000/year in income.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires the work to be location-independent, performed remotely for a company or clients based outside Barbados; taking up local employment is not covered by this stamp.
requirements.fix_path: Confirm the work is genuinely location-independent and not for a Barbados-based employer.

evidence_required.document: Passport bio-data page and 2 passport-sized photographs
Birth certificate(s) and proof of dependant relationships (for family bundles)
Non-refundable fee, due within 28 days of approval: USD 2,000 (individual) or USD 3,000 (family bundle)

sources.title: Barbados Tourism Marketing Inc. (visitbarbados.org) -- Barbados Welcome Stamp requirements
Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Foreign Trade of Barbados (foreign.gov.bb) -- Barbados Welcome Stamp Programme
Government Information Service, Barbados (gisbarbados.gov.bb) -- Barbados Welcome Stamp Visa Goes Live

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Barbados' initial build -- one of the earliest programmes of this type globally (announced July 2020). Genuinely favourable tax treatment confirmed at tier-1: holders are 'not liable to pay Barbados Income Tax' on remote work performed for entities outside Barbados, though they remain subject to Barbados' 17.5% VAT on local purchases -- a distinctive structural feature worth surfacing the way Spain's Beckham-regime note does for es_dnv. leads_to_pr is explicitly false: the visitbarbados.org page states plainly that this visa does not indicate a path to permanent residency. Applicants seeking local employment, or with derogatory background reports, are refused -- confirmed via foreign.gov.bb press material citing 60 refusals on those grounds as of the source's reporting date. family_can_work and study_rights are omitted rather than guessed -- not addressed by any source fetched in this pass.
